name: KnowLogic
description: KnowLogic is a benchmark for commonsense reasoning generated through knowledge-driven synthetic data synthesis, integrating diverse commonsense knowledge and logical reasoning with adjustable difficulty levels. It includes 3,000 bilingual questions (Chinese and English) with fine-grained labels for in-depth evaluation of reasoning abilities.
reputation: A relatively new synthetic commonsense benchmark with limited but growing use in Chinese-English reasoning evaluation.
notes: Synthetic data with adjustable difficulty; bilingual (Chinese and English); highest model accuracy ~69.57%; highlights common reasoning errors.
